info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Wholesale Trading Suitability Checking-spec
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Suitability Checking API facilitates the assessment of clients' eligibility for wholesale trading services. This endpoint allows businesses to submit and evaluate suitability checks based on client information and trading profiles. Typical consumers include financial institutions and brokers looking to ensure compliance with regulatory standards before engaging clients in wholesale trading activities. By leveraging this API, firms can streamline their onboarding processes and mitigate risks associated with unsuitable transactions.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit a suitability check request for wholesale trading. The request will evaluate whether a particular product or service is suitable for a specific client based on their needs and circumstances.
